MSFT.label: HR2847: AI Accountability and Data Privacy Act
MSFT.desc: Requires developers of large AI systems to publish safety evaluations and gives the FTC authority over consumer data used in model training. — Latest action 2026-07-20: Reported out of House Energy and Commerce Committee.

XOM.label: S1104: Strategic Petroleum Reserve Modernization Act
XOM.desc: Directs the Department of Energy to modernize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve and sets refill price bands. — Latest action 2026-07-11: Hearings held by Senate Energy and Natural Resources Committee.

NVAX.label: HR3120: Pandemic Preparedness and Vaccine Manufacturing Act
NVAX.desc: Funds domestic vaccine manufacturing capacity and creates advance-purchase authority for next-generation protein-based vaccines. — Latest action 2026-07-25: Referred to House Appropriations Subcommittee.

TSM.label: S2210: American Semiconductor Supply Chain Security Act
TSM.desc: Extends CHIPS-era investment credits to foreign foundries expanding US fabrication capacity and tightens export-control review. — Latest action 2026-07-18: Placed on Senate legislative calendar.
